name: Dislocating
body:
Aura strong conjuration; CL 13th; Craft Magic Arms and Armor; teleport attack; Price +2 bonus.

DESCRIPTION

Three times per day, any creature struck in combat must succeed on a Will save (DC 10 + ½ the wielder’s character level + the wielder’s Strength or Dexterity modifier) or be subject to a teleport attack.
